clips.text_zh: 又見人討論點解BTC一升15%就有人想追。睇咗幾個禮拜唔郁，升咗即刻FOMO。CFD又輸緊，呢個pattern真係熟。🙏
clips.text_en_b1: Why do people buy BTC after the pump? You watch BTC do nothing for weeks, ignore it completely. Then it pumps 15% and suddenly everyone wants in. Why does everyone want to buy after the move already happened? Classic retail behavior.
clips.source_hint: /biz/ thread about BTC retail buying after pumps
clips.text_en_b2: What is it about a 15% BTC pump that suddenly makes everyone want to jump in? You can watch the chart sit flat for weeks on end, ignore it entirely, and then the moment it actually moves, FOMO kicks in and retail floods back in. CFD players keep getting blown out chasing moves that have already happened, which is a textbook pattern. Same story, different cycle.
clips.text_en_c1: The compulsion to chase BTC the moment it rallies never ceases to baffle me. One can observe the price stagnating for weeks on end, summarily dismissing it as dead money, only to witness a fifteen percent surge and immediately feel that visceral FOMO kicking in. By then, anyone entering has effectively become liquidity for those who positioned earlier. Those leveraged through CFDs are, predictably, getting obliterated once again, as though the pattern has become almost ritualistic. It is the textbook hallmark of retail trading psychology, repeated ad nauseam across every cycle, with each new cohort convinced that this time the momentum is genuinely sustainable and that the consolidation phase is…
clips.text_en_c2: The perennial question resurfaces whenever Bitcoin mounts a meaningful rally: why do retail participants feel compelled to enter precisely after the move has crystallised? One observes weeks, sometimes an entire month, of lateral consolidation during which the asset is roundly dismissed, only for a fifteen-percent surge to galvanise immediate buy-side enthusiasm. The phenomenon, while psychologically explicable through FOMO dynamics and recency bias, exemplifies a recurring behavioural pathology endemic to retail speculation. Whether the instrument is spot Bitcoin or leveraged CFDs, the temporal signature remains identical: conviction arrives precisely when the risk-reward asymmetry has degraded most acutely, and those who waited out the boredom are now conspicuously absent.

clips.text_zh: DOGE又有人話跟maid就贏。9,150粒DOGE想溝到25,000等佢上£1買AE86。wtf我CFD都爆咗倉，仲想溝貨。lol
clips.text_en_b1: BTC. XRP. DOGE. All you literally had to do was follow the maid. That is all you had to hold. One anon has 9,150 DOGE and wants to build up to 25,000 in case it hits £1 to buy a Toyota AE86.
clips.source_hint: /biz/ thread about holding DOGE and following the maid
clips.text_en_b2: BTC, XRP, DOGE — honestly, all you had to do was follow the maid and simply hold. One anonymous poster is sitting on 9,150 DOGE and wants to average down to 25,000 coins on the off chance it eventually hits £1, at which point he plans to buy a Toyota AE86. Meanwhile CFD traders keep getting liquidated trying to catch the same move, which says everything about retail timing.
clips.text_en_c1: The prevailing wisdom on certain boards holds that one merely had to follow the maid's portfolio allocations. Bitcoin, XRP, DOGE; simply holding whichever position she endorsed was, in retrospect, sufficient. One anonymous participant currently holds 9,150 DOGE and aspires to accumulate 25,000, ostensibly on the premise that a pound valuation would finance the acquisition of a Toyota AE86, an aspiration that seems rather ambitious given prevailing market dynamics. Meanwhile, those who opted for CFD exposure have, unsurprisingly, seen their positions liquidated. The irony of attempting to average into an asset whose recent performance has been underwhelming hardly needs elaboration, yet retail optimism persists regardless.
clips.text_en_c2: The thesis, articulated with characteristic 4chan economy, remains seductively simple: BTC, XRP, DOGE — all one had to do, ostensibly, was follow the maid and hold. One anonymous participant currently holds 9,150 DOGE and aspires to accumulate a position of 25,000 tokens, contingent upon the asset reaching the psychologically resonant threshold of £1 per coin, ostensibly to finance the acquisition of a Toyota AE86. Whether the projected price target constitutes rational expectation or elaborate cope remains a matter of considerable dispute; what is undeniable is that such positions, predicated on transformational but improbable price action, routinely terminate in margin calls rather than automotive procurement. The pattern is, by now, almost quaint.

clips.text_zh: Debian俾印度人接管，即刻用AI vibecoding整個OS。HAHAHA。咁我哋呢啲engineer仲有得撈？AI連Linux都要食埋。🧐
clips.text_en_b1: DEBIAN NOW INDIAN AI SLOP. An Indian takes over the Debian Project. Immediately they begin vibecoding the entire operating system. So what is the stable distro of the future, Mageia or OpenMandriva? Phoronix covered the responsible AI vote.
clips.text_en_b2: Apparently the Debian Project has effectively been taken over by Indian developers, and the immediate response has been to start vibecoding major parts of the operating system with AI. So the real question becomes: what is the actually stable distro going to be going forward, Mageia or OpenMandriva? Phoronix already covered the vote on responsible AI use, and the results were not encouraging for traditionalists.
clips.text_en_c1: The Debian project has effectively fallen under Indian stewardship, and the immediate consequence appears to be the wholesale vibecoding of an entire operating system through generative AI tools. Whether this constitutes responsible governance or merely accelerated enshittification remains a matter of considerable debate within the Linux community. Critics are already wondering what the ostensibly stable distribution of the future might be, with Mageia and OpenMandriva being cited as plausible alternatives should Debian's trajectory prove irreparably compromised. Phoronix has, to their credit, covered the responsible AI vote in question, though one suspects the broader engineering community will have the final word on whether this constitutes progress or capitulation.
clips.text_en_c2: The discourse surrounding the Debian Project's perceived inflection point has acquired a distinctly satirical tenor. With an Indian maintainer assuming a prominent role within the project's governance, critics have framed the subsequent adoption of AI-assisted vibecoding practices as emblematic of a broader degradation in software stewardship. Whether one characterises this as organic evolution or, in the colourful vernacular of /g/, 'AI slop,' the underlying anxiety is substantive: if large language models are now adjudicating responsible-AI policy votes and contributing patches to foundational operating systems, what residual economic justification remains for human systems engineers? The thread, predictably, reaches no consensus — though Mageia and OpenMandriva were cited as plausible inheritors should Debian's institutional credibility erode beyond salvage.

clips.text_zh: 有人講印度移民點解被睇衰，攞UK、丹麥、荷蘭、瑞典、加拿大犯罪率數據出嚟，話印度人犯罪率最低。HK啲人睇到呢啲post會點講？
clips.text_en_b1: Why are Indian immigrants viewed negatively despite their strong economic and social outcomes? Crime stats from UK, Denmark, Netherlands, Sweden, Canada, and Finland show Indians are always among the lowest crime groups, along with Chinese. Net economic contribution is also positive in the US, UK, and Germany.
clips.source_hint: /pol/ thread defending Indian immigrants with crime stats
clips.text_en_b2: Why do Indian immigrants get viewed so negatively when their economic and social outcomes are clearly strong? Crime statistics across the UK, Denmark, the Netherlands, Sweden, Canada, and Finland consistently show Indians among the lowest-crime groups, alongside Chinese communities. Net fiscal contribution in the US, UK, and Germany is positive as well. It is a striking gap between perception and the actual data.
clips.text_en_c1: The question of why Indian immigrants are disproportionately viewed negatively, given their demonstrably strong economic and social outcomes, warrants serious empirical consideration. Crime statistics drawn from the United Kingdom, Denmark, the Netherlands, Sweden, Canada, and Finland consistently place Indians among the lowest-crime demographic cohorts, alongside Chinese immigrants. Net fiscal contribution, meanwhile, remains decidedly positive across the United States, United Kingdom, and Germany, which renders the prevailing hostility all the more puzzling. Were Hong Kong discourse to encounter such data, the cognitive dissonance between lived perception and statistical reality would likely prove considerable, given the territory's deeply entrenched attitudes toward South Asian populations.
clips.text_en_c2: The proposition under examination challenges a prevailing narrative: that Indian diaspora communities, frequently cast in unflattering terms across Western discourse, in fact exhibit socioeconomic outcomes that confound such characterisation. Aggregated crime statistics drawn from the United Kingdom, Denmark, the Netherlands, Sweden, Canada, and Finland consistently place individuals of Indian and Chinese origin among the lowest-incidence demographic cohorts for violent and property crime. Parallel data regarding fiscal contribution, particularly within the United States, United Kingdom, and Germany, suggest a net positive economic transfer rather than the parasitic extraction commonly alleged. The question posed — how a Hong Kong audience might receive such a thesis given local political sensibilities — gestures toward a more uncomfortable subtext about which immigrant groups bear the brunt of comparable scrutiny, and to what end.

clips.text_zh: GTA6個Lucia 5呎2可以一拳K.O. 6呎3男人。連shotgun都得單手reload。網民話係woke。我打LOL都冇時間，邊有時間玩GTA。
clips.text_en_b1: GTA 6 is fine but Lucia is immersion breaking. A 5 foot 2 girl that can knock out a 6 foot 3 man with one punch. She can shoot and drive at superhuman levels and even reloads shotguns with one hand. Some fans online are calling it woke.
clips.source_hint: /v/ thread complaining about Lucia's unrealistic combat stats
clips.text_en_b2: GTA 6 itself looks fine, but Lucia genuinely breaks immersion. A 5'2 character who can knock out a 6'3 man with a single punch, then proceed to shoot, drive, and reload a shotgun one-handed at near-superhuman levels. Certain segments of the fanbase are already branding it as woke, although plenty of others simply do not have the time to care between ranked matches.
clips.text_en_c1: GTA 6 is, by most measurable standards, a competent title, though Lucia's physical capabilities strain credulity to a rather significant degree. A five-foot-two protagonist who can incapacitate a six-foot-three adversary with a single blow, who exhibits superhuman marksmanship behind the wheel, and who reloads a shotgun one-handed without the slightest difficulty represents a suspension of disbelief that even the franchise's established liberties cannot fully accommodate. Certain segments of the online community have predictably labelled these design choices as evidence of supposed wokeness infiltrating the series, though the mechanics themselves appear to prioritise spectacle over realism. One hardly has time for League of Legends, let alone this.
clips.text_en_c2: The forthcoming Grand Theft Auto VI has occasioned considerable aesthetic dispute, centring principally upon the physical portrayal of its female protagonist, Lucia. Standing at approximately five foot two, the character is depicted incapacitating male antagonists of six foot three or greater with singular punches, wielding firearms with implausible proficiency, operating motor vehicles at superhuman cadence, and — most egregiously, in the estimation of critics — reloading a pump-action shotgun one-handed. Detractors have coalesced around the familiar 'woke' designation, though whether the objection pertains to representational politics or merely to a tonal dissonance between the franchise's established grittiness and its newfound ludic sensibility remains, upon honest inspection, somewhat ambiguous. Immersion, it should be acknowledged, is a fragile contract.

clips.text_zh: 有人3個月減45磅但掉晒肌肉。Gym好攰，protein又食唔落。我都瘦緊，但唔想變廢柴。肥仔信話一齊gym都得，等考完牌先。
clips.text_en_b1: How the hell can you lift heavy and get enough protein on a cut? I lost 45 pounds in 3 months but definitely lost muscle and strength. Being at the gym kills me. I get too fatigued. And eating is a struggle too.
clips.source_hint: /fit/ thread about losing muscle during a 45lb cut
clips.text_en_b2: How on earth are you supposed to lift heavy and hit your protein targets while running an aggressive cut? I dropped 45 pounds in three months and clearly lost both muscle and strength along the way. Training leaves me completely drained, and forcing food down has become a chore. Some friends suggested we hit the gym together once exams are out of the way.
clips.text_en_c1: The fundamental paradox of cutting weight whilst preserving lean mass and adequate strength is something I find genuinely maddening. Having shed roughly forty-five pounds over three months, I can attest that substantial muscle attrition accompanied the fat loss, which is hardly the outcome one desires. The gym sessions themselves become punishingly exhausting, particularly when caloric intake is restricted to the degree that recovery becomes compromised. Consuming sufficient protein to maintain anabolism under such conditions is, frankly, an uphill battle, as appetite suppression renders hitting one's macros an exercise in discipline rather than pleasure. A friend has suggested we train together once his licensing examinations conclude.
clips.text_en_c2: The caloric deficit required for aggressive weight reduction imposes physiological constraints that compound in decidedly unwelcome ways. A correspondent reports having shed forty-five pounds over a three-month window — a pace sufficient to guarantee substantial lean-mass attrition alongside the intended fat loss. Concurrent resistance training becomes a Sisyphean endeavour: the requisite protein intake, typically elevated to mitigate catabolism, exceeds the dieter's reduced appetite threshold, while sessions themselves are characterised by a crushing, generalised fatigue that no quantity of stimulant or willpower fully dispels. The correspondent's concluding observation — that those of similarly ample frame may yet share a squat rack once examinations conclude — captures, perhaps inadvertently, the modest therapeutic value of communal exertion amidst what is otherwise a fairly bleak metabolic arithmetic.

clips.text_zh: /a/有人問sultry tomboy加巨大胸部係咪最強角色motif。睇咗咁多年動漫我都覺得係。Gundam 00年代就係靠呢個pattern食飯。lol
clips.text_en_b1: Sultry tomboy with huge breasts. Is there a better character motif in anime? Anonymous asks /a/ if any trope beats this classic combination. The thread debates classic and modern examples from shonen and slice-of-life shows.
clips.source_hint: /a/ thread debating the sultry tomboy trope
clips.text_en_b2: Is there genuinely a stronger character motif in anime than the sultry tomboy paired with an absurdly large chest? An anonymous poster posed the question on /a/, and honestly, after years of watching the medium, it is hard to argue against. Shows from the Gundam 00 era basically built their entire appeal around that exact combination, and modern series still lean on it heavily.
clips.text_en_c1: The archetype of the sultry tomboy endowed with disproportionately generous proportions is, I would argue, among the most enduring character motifs that anime has ever produced. A recent thread on the board posed precisely this question: what trope could conceivably surpass this particular combination of tomboyish defiance and exaggerated physicality? Respondents cited examples spanning both shonen battle franchises and the more sedate slice-of-life genre, though consensus held that the Gundam 00 era, with its roster of precisely such characters, represented something of a golden age for the formula. Whether modern productions can replicate that particular alchemy remains, however, an open question.
clips.text_en_c2: The proposition advanced within /a/ is, on its surface, deliberately facetious; upon sustained reflection, however, it discloses a genuine semiotic insight. The archetype combining tomboyish insouciance with exaggerated secondary sexual characteristics occupies such a disproportionate share of the medium's character design vocabulary that its hegemony scarcely requires empirical defence. From the mecha heroines of the Gundam 00 era — whose commercial fortunes were, indeed, substantially leveraged upon precisely this formula — through to contemporary shonen and slice-of-life productions, the trope persists because it answers, with commendable efficiency, two apparently incompatible aesthetic appetites: the viewer's predilection for characterisation that signals autonomy and combat competence, and an equally durable, if less publicly defended, appetite for visual abundance. One wonders whether any rival motif genuinely competes.
